question: Which of our commercial lending clients also have more than $5 million of capital-markets credit exposure, and what is each one's combined exposure?
answer:
I found **14 commercial lending clients** with more than $5 million of capital-markets current exposure at 2026-09-30. Together they have **$546.1M of combined exposure**: $244.9M of active lending commitments plus $301.2M of capital-markets current exposure.

| # | Client (CIF) | Segment | Capital-markets exposure | Lending commitment (drawn) | **Combined** |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Harrowgate Health Co (0000042498) | MM | $37.16M | $29.20M ($17.12M) | **$66.36M** |
| 2 | Pinecrest Valley Group LLC (0000041850) | MM | $38.83M | $20.45M ($17.19M) | **$59.28M** |
| 3 | Kestrel Automation Systems LLC (0000041022) | LC | $6.50M | $45.00M ($31.67M) | **$51.50M** |
| 4 | Pinecrest Properties Inc (0000042036) | MM | $32.04M | $13.85M ($11.14M) | **$45.89M** |
| 5 | Yarrowby Industries LLC (0000041642) | LC | $33.32M | $7.30M ($4.29M) | **$40.62M** |
| 6 | Foxmere Valley Holdings LLC (0000042083) | MM | $31.63M | $8.10M ($7.12M) | **$39.73M** |
| 7 | Calloway Health Inc (0000042648) | MM | $24.27M | $14.25M ($6.64M) | **$38.52M** |
| 8 | Ravensholm Systems Inc (0000041539) | LC | $33.62M | $2.60M ($1.75M) | **$36.22M** |
| 9 | Ivorline Services Inc (0000041974) | MM | $7.15M | $24.10M ($9.41M) | **$31.25M** |
| 10 | Blackridge Supply LLC (0000042657) | MM | $12.14M | $17.65M ($0.00M) | **$29.79M** |
| 11 | Dunmore Energy Inc (0000041168) | LC | $6.14M | $23.10M ($14.96M) | **$29.24M** |
| 12 | Pinecrest Distribution LLC (0000042037) | MM | $10.77M | $16.25M ($12.98M) | **$27.02M** |
| 13 | Kingsmere Ridge Group LLC (0000042233) | MM | $18.44M | $8.40M ($4.06M) | **$26.84M** |
| 14 | Hollinsby Engineering Co (0000042452) | MM | $9.17M | $14.65M ($10.13M) | **$23.82M** |

If you count only drawn balances instead of full commitments, the combined total falls to $449.6M ($148.5M drawn plus $301.2M capital-markets).

**Credit points to flag**
- **Two of these clients have charged-off loans.** These are not counted in the figures above:
  - Pinecrest Valley Group: an equipment loan charged off on 2026-03-15 ($1.34M still showing as drawn, 349 days past due). Its remaining active facilities are rated 6 and 7.
  - Kingsmere Ridge Group: an equipment loan charged off on 2026-07-15 ($6.25M still showing as drawn, 227 days past due). Its remaining active facilities are rated 3 and 7.
- **The Pinecrest names add up.** Pinecrest Valley Group, Pinecrest Properties and Pinecrest Distribution total $132.2M combined. There is also a Pinecrest Macro Fund LP with $19.05M of capital-markets exposure that has no client number. A review at the parent-group level is worth doing; I measured each legal client on its own and did not roll up ownership.
- **Ravensholm and Yarrowby** carry more than $33M of capital-markets exposure each, against small loans rated 6.

**Excluded, with reasons**
- **Halvorsen Capital Services LLC** ($22.0M capital-markets exposure) is a client but has no lending facilities, so it isn't a lending client.
- **Five funds or broker-dealers** have more than $5M of capital-markets exposure each ($86.9M in total) but no client number and no name match in our client list: the Moorcroft Global Opportunities, Pinecrest Macro, Moorcroft Macro and Brandvold Macro funds, and Hollinsby Capital Markets LLC.

**Sources and definitions**
- **Capital-markets exposure:** current exposure (positive mark-to-market) from the risk platform's trade-level exposure table at 2026-09-30, summed by legal entity across all four product types (interest-rate swaps, cross-currency swaps, FX forwards, commodity swaps). It does not include potential future exposure or any netting or collateral, and notional amounts are not used. I did not use the archive table.
- **Matching:** each risk-platform legal entity carries a client number reference (5 digits). I padded it to the 10-digit client number used in the lending system. Every entity with a reference maps to exactly one client.
- **Lending client:** a client with at least one active facility. Exposure is the active commitment (drawn plus undrawn, checked against the 2026-09-30 month-end balances). It includes standby letters of credit and excludes paid-off and charged-off facilities.
- **Combined exposure:** lending commitment plus capital-markets current exposure.
- **Threshold:** "more than $5 million" is applied to capital-markets exposure only, per legal entity.
- **Assumption:** 1,071 active facilities are past their maturity date but still carry balances. I counted them as active, as the system records them.
- No restricted data (such as the financial-crime case table) was used.

sql.sql: SELECT SNAP_DT, PRODUCT, COUNT(*) n, COUNT(DISTINCT TRADE_ID) trades, COUNT(DISTINCT ENTITY_ID) ents, SUM(CURRENT_EXPOSURE) ce, SUM(CASE WHEN CURRENT_EXPOSURE<0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) neg, SUM(CASE WHEN CURRENT_EXPOSURE IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) nulls FROM dbo.CM_EXPOSURE GROUP BY SNAP_DT, PRODUCT ORDER BY SNAP_DT, PRODUCT

SELECT ENTITY_TYP, COUNT(*) n, SUM(CASE WHEN CIF_REF IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) with_cif, MIN(LEN(CIF_REF)) minlen, MAX(LEN(CIF_REF)) maxlen, COUNT(DISTINCT CIF_REF) dist_cif FROM dbo.LEGAL_ENTITY GROUP BY ENTITY_TYP
SELECT COUNT(*) n, COUNT(DISTINCT CIF_REF) d, COUNT(DISTINCT ENTITY_ID) de FROM dbo.LEGAL_ENTITY WHERE CIF_REF IS NOT NULL
SELECT client_status, segment_cd, COUNT(*) n, COUNT(DISTINCT cif_no) d, MIN(LENGTH(cif_no)) mn, MAX(LENGTH(cif_no)) mx FROM BANK_DEMO.CORE.CLIENT GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT f.product_cd, p.product_nm, p.product_family, p.on_bs_flg, f.facility_status, COUNT(*) n, SUM(f.commit_amt) commit FROM BANK_DEMO.LENDING.FACILITY f LEFT JOIN BANK_DEMO.REF.PRODUCT p ON p.product_cd=f.product_cd GROUP BY 1,2,3,4,5 ORDER BY 1,5

SELECT f.facility_status, COUNT(DISTINCT f.facility_id) fac, COUNT(b.facility_id) with_bal, SUM(f.commit_amt) commit, SUM(b.drawn_amt) drawn, SUM(b.undrawn_amt) undrawn, SUM(CASE WHEN ABS(b.drawn_amt+b.undrawn_amt-f.commit_amt)>1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) mismatch, SUM(CASE WHEN f.maturity_dt < '2026-09-30' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) past_mat FROM BANK_DEMO.LENDING.FACILITY f LEFT JOIN BANK_DEMO.LENDING.FACILITY_BAL_MTHLY b ON b.facility_id=f.facility_id AND b.snap_dt='2026-09-30' GROUP BY 1
SELECT snap_dt, COUNT(*) n, COUNT(DISTINCT facility_id) d FROM BANK_DEMO.LENDING.FACILITY_BAL_MTHLY WHERE snap_dt>='2026-07-31' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT e.ENTITY_ID, e.ENTITY_NM, e.ENTITY_TYP, e.CIF_REF, COUNT(*) trades, SUM(c.NOTIONAL_AMT) notional, SUM(c.CURRENT_EXPOSURE) ce FROM dbo.CM_EXPOSURE c JOIN dbo.LEGAL_ENTITY e ON e.ENTITY_ID=c.ENTITY_ID WHERE c.SNAP_DT='2026-09-30' GROUP BY e.ENTITY_ID, e.ENTITY_NM, e.ENTITY_TYP, e.CIF_REF HAVING SUM(c.CURRENT_EXPOSURE) > 5000000 ORDER BY ce DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) n, SUM(CASE WHEN e.ENTITY_ID IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) orphan FROM dbo.CM_EXPOSURE c LEFT JOIN dbo.LEGAL_ENTITY e ON e.ENTITY_ID=c.ENTITY_ID WHERE c.SNAP_DT='2026-09-30'

SELECT c.cif_no, c.client_nm, c.segment_cd, c.client_status,
 COUNT(CASE WHEN f.facility_status='ACTIVE' THEN 1 END) active_fac,
 SUM(CASE WHEN f.facility_status='ACTIVE' THEN f.commit_amt END) commit_amt,
 SUM(CASE WHEN f.facility_status='ACTIVE' THEN b.drawn_amt END) drawn,
 SUM(CASE WHEN f.facility_status='ACTIVE' THEN b.undrawn_amt END) undrawn,
 COUNT(CASE WHEN f.facility_status<>'ACTIVE' THEN 1 END) inactive_fac,
 MAX(CASE WHEN f.facility_status='ACTIVE' THEN f.risk_rating END) worst_rr
FROM BANK_DEMO.CORE.CLIENT c
LEFT JOIN BANK_DEMO.LENDING.FACILITY f ON f.cif_no=c.cif_no
LEFT JOIN BANK_DEMO.LENDING.FACILITY_BAL_MTHLY b ON b.facility_id=f.facility_id AND b.snap_dt='2026-09-30'
WHERE c.cif_no IN ('0000041850','0000042498','0000041539','0000041642','0000042036','0000042083','0000042648','0000041002','0000042233','0000042657','0000042037','0000042452','0000041974','0000041022','0000041168')
GROUP BY 1,2,3,4 ORDER BY 1

SELECT cif_no, client_nm, segment_cd FROM BANK_DEMO.CORE.CLIENT WHERE client_nm ILIKE '%Fund%' OR client_nm ILIKE '%Moorcroft%' OR client_nm ILIKE '%Brandvold%' OR client_nm ILIKE '%Capital Markets%' OR client_nm ILIKE '%Macro%'

SELECT f.cif_no, f.facility_id, f.product_cd, f.facility_status, f.commit_amt, f.payoff_dt, f.chgoff_dt, f.risk_rating, b.drawn_amt, b.dpd, b.accrual_stat FROM BANK_DEMO.LENDING.FACILITY f LEFT JOIN BANK_DEMO.LENDING.FACILITY_BAL_MTHLY b ON b.facility_id=f.facility_id AND b.snap_dt='2026-09-30' WHERE f.cif_no IN ('0000041850','0000042233','0000041002','0000041539','0000041642') ORDER BY 1,2
